# Flex Order

::: info 实现进度 55% · 进行中
Playground 已 `@source` 文档 markdown，这些类名可在本页示例里跑。未写入 `helpers.css`；SDK 里 schema 动态 class 仍依赖源码扫描。`m:` / `pc:` 只接到间距和宽高。
:::

不改 schema 顺序，只改视觉顺序。

```schema
type: page
body:
  - type: tpl
    className: flex gap-2
    tpl: '<span class="order-3 bg-muted p-sm rounded-md">A order-3</span><span class="order-1 bg-muted p-sm rounded-md">B order-1</span><span class="order-2 bg-muted p-sm rounded-md">C order-2</span>'
```

## 类名

| Class | Properties |
| --- | --- |
| `order-first` | `order: -9999` |
| `order-last` | `order: 9999` |
| `order-none` | `order: 0` |
| `order-1` | `order: 1` |
| `order-2` | `order: 2` |
| `order-3` | `order: 3` |

响应式：`m:` / `pc:` 目前只接到间距和宽高辅助类。其它类请用 Tailwind 断点（`max-md:` / `md:`）。状态前缀见 [辅助类-状态样式](/style/state)。
